items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Eric and I were very close

ctx.x: Eric and I were very close, but I couldn’t get that feeling. I couldn’t get that kind of feeling with notes or anything. When I would get to California during the time I was with Sarah, Eric – we’d be together almost all the time. Then he was playing more like Bird. But after, when the change – when he went the other direction, some of the stuff I didn’t understand. I know he got interesting compositions. But what he was playing, it didn’t hit me here like that, like Trane. I didn’t feel that. And that was my…
I’d just like to state this is tape number two, Jazz Oral History Program interview with Roy Haynes in his home in Long Island. This is May 15th, 1994.
